name: University of Victoria
summary: Victoria, BC campus with 22,000+ students and 280+ programs; engineering and other degrees offer paid co-op work terms.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with three HL subjects and English at 3 or better; program pages give an estimated score of 26 to 30 points excluding bonus points. Maths AI SL is not accepted where Maths is required.

dates.label: Application deadline, most degree programs, September entry

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A general first year of engineering courses, then you declare biomedical, civil, computer, electrical, mechanical or software engineering. Paid four-month co-op terms with employers are part of UVic's engineering offer.
programmes.ib: Three or more HL; English 3+, Maths (AA, or AI HL) 4+, Chemistry and Physics 4+; AI SL is not accepted. Estimated 30 points excluding bonus points.
programmes.selectionNote: Academic performance decides. 30 points is an estimate from recent cycles and the score needed may be higher; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

flagshipSource.title: UVic Engineering and Computer Science guide: paid four-month co-op terms with named employers

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: A hands-on, collaborative degree in how systems work and software is built, with combined options such as Data Science, Mathematics, Music or Health Information Science, and co-op work terms.
programmes.ib: Three or more HL; English 3+, Maths (AA, or AI HL) 4+, one science at HL or SL; AI SL is not accepted. Estimated 27 points excluding bonus points.
programmes.selectionNote: Academic performance decides. 27 points is an estimate from recent cycles and the score needed may be higher; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

flagshipSource.title: UVic Engineering and Computer Science guide: paid four-month co-op terms with named employers

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Computer Science
faculties.line: Maths, Chemistry and Physics at 4+ for engineering; Computer Science needs Maths and one science; estimated 27 to 30 points.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: Biology: Maths 4+ (AI SL not accepted) and two lab sciences; estimated 30 points excluding bonus points.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: Economics needs no subject beyond English 3+; estimated 28 points; Psychology likewise at 28.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities
faculties.line: English and History need only English 3+ and three HL subjects; estimated 27 points excluding bonus points.

faculties.name: Faculty of Fine Arts
faculties.line: Visual Arts: English 3+, estimated 26 points, and a digital portfolio is required.

faculties.name: Gustavson School of Business
faculties.line: Maths (AA, or AI HL) at 4+, English 3+ and three HL; estimated 30 points; four-year degree with work terms.

notes: Estimated IB scores on UVic's program pages come from recent admission cycles and exclude bonus points; the score needed may be higher in future.
UVic gives up to one year of transfer credit for a full IB Diploma with minimum subject scores, and entrance scholarships based on IB scores.
UVic sets its September-entry deadline per program: most degree programs close 31 January, and some programs keep accepting applications after it.
